title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.39633v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One-step and few-step text-to-image generation must accurately render the details specified in the prompt despite limited opportunities for refinement. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) uses score differences to bring the generated distribution closer to a reference distribution. Following prior work, we estimate this difference with internal velocity branches, avoiding a separate fake-score network. We ask whether an explicit moment constraint improves this learned score supervision. A decomposition of the reverse-KL field into a Gaussian moment component and a non-Gaussian residual identifies statistics that can be constrained explicitly. We introduce Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM), which retains the full DMD correction and matches feature means and per-coordinate standard deviations using the generator's exponential-moving-average (EMA) copy, requiring no external feature encoder. translated_abstract: 一步和少步文本到图像生成必须在有限的精炼机会下，准确呈现提示词中指定的细节。分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）利用分数差异使生成分布更接近参考分布。延续先前的工作，我们使用内部速度分支来估计这一差异，从而避免使用单独的伪分数网络。我们探究显式的矩约束是否能改进这种学习到的分数监督。通过将反向KL散度场分解为高斯矩分量和非高斯残差，我们识别出可以显式约束的统计量。我们提出了内在分布匹配（IDM），它在保留完整DMD校正的同时，利用生成器的指数移动平均（EMA）副本来匹配特征均值和逐坐标标准差，无需外部特征编码器。实验采用全参数和低（原文在此截断）……
tldr: 提出内在分布匹配（IDM），在保留完整DMD校正的基础上，利用生成器的EMA副本显式匹配特征均值与逐坐标标准差，无需外部特征编码器，从而改进一步/少步文本到图像生成。
en_tdlr: We propose Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM), which retains the full DMD correction and explicitly matches feature means and per-coordinate standard deviations using the generator's EMA copy without any external feature encoder, improving one-step and few-step text-to-image generation.
